svg.title: Two generations around 2012
svg.desc: The outgoing 987.2 base Boxster uses a 2.9-litre port-injected engine with 188 kW or 255 PS, the same family as the 2010 reference car. The incoming 981 base Boxster uses a 2.7-litre direct-injected engine with 195 kW or 265 PS. It was announced in January 2012, with a planned Dutch dealer introduction of 14 April 2012. The announcement is not a first-delivery record. First registration in 2012 does not establish which generation it is. Check the generation, model year, build date and original market before choosing a brochure.

g.text: model year, build date and market.
